categories.evidence: One strict V2 contract and exact bigint evaluator drive simulation and live worker behavior; precedence, caps, explanations, refunds, and V1 compatibility pass.
Database entitlement and publication guards, tenant RLS, narrow grants, bounded signed ingestion, replay protection, and public-selector authority derivation pass adversarial tests.
Serialized cap accounting, idempotency, evaluation evidence, per-rule usage, and balanced ledger commit are atomic; V1 immutable replay is unchanged.
The release gate passed 221 workspace tests, 29 pgTAP files with 1200 assertions, concurrency/property probes, both images, and all four WooCommerce runtime cells.
Evaluation is bounded, exact, indexed, and free of per-rule database round trips; production load-envelope measurement remains an M15 gate.
Tenant canary, source health, immutable evidence, guarded deployment rollback, recovery prerequisite, and value-preserving disable path are documented and production-smoked.
Contracts, shared evaluator, migrations, worker, plugin, UI, ADRs, API/security docs, tests, score, tasks, and production evidence remain versioned and synchronized.
